_note: F-031. Per-creature identity clause + humanoid silhouette anchor, keyed by BESTIARY DESIGN ID. buildCreaturePrompt() (generate/charsheet.mjs) appends style-laws.json's styleClause LAST, after the clause — the same F-024 law job-costume.json follows; putting the style words in the opening `positive` array does not reproduce the validated prompt string. Both entries are validated:false — authored from the bestiary row's visualBrief, NOT yet visually confirmed on a contact sheet. QC each on its own row before trusting it, exactly as job-costume.json's seven unvalidated jobs. HARD LIMIT: only humanoid-raider body plans can be generated at all. The `character` profile is img2img anchored on silhouettes cut from the approved human row, and style-laws law #1 says text alone cannot hold head-body ratio — so quadrupeds, insects, plants and hulks (92 of the 116 designs) have no anchor and are out of reach until a non-humanoid silhouette set exists.

mob-bramble-stalker.clause: a PLANT MONSTER made entirely of woven green bramble cane, a walking bramble thicket, bare cane and thorn throughout — skinless, hairless, unclothed, its whole body bundled living cane, two long whip-arms of hooked thorn instead of hands, headless — a dark hollow opening where a face would be, trailing roots instead of feet, bark-black old wood and bright green new growth
mob-bramble-stalker._why: sil-assassin: the closest humanoid anchor to a fast, light, two-armed skirmisher. Confirmed present on mont-pc at F:\comfy-ui\input (2026-08-05). The FIRST clause — a lightly-worded restatement of the bestiary visualBrief — FAILED QC at seed 12345: at denoise 0.82 the human silhouette dominated and the model returned a black-shaded ninja holding bamboo. The SECOND clause fought the anchor explicitly and was VALIDATED 2026-08-05 against art:mob-bramble-stalker at seed 88421; it is kept verbatim in `_clauseAsValidated`. Known deviation in the approved image: the dark hollow sits at head height, not chest height as the bestiary row says — accepted, it reads better at game scale. F-039 (2026-08-08) REWROTE the live clause and reset validated to false. The validated clause carried five negations (NOT a person, NOT a ninja, no clothing, no skin, no hair) and its old note said 'keep those negations'. That instruction cannot survive the F-039 finding: a text encoder has no operator for negation, so those five phrases were delivering `person`, `ninja`, `clothing`, `skin` and `hair` into the positive conditioning — i.e. reinforcing the very ninja read they were meant to suppress. The plausible reading of that QC pass is that PLANT MONSTER / bramble cane / whip-arms did the work and the negations rode along. The new clause states the same exclusions as assertions ('skinless, hairless, unclothed', 'a walking bramble thicket'), which is negation-free and keeps the anchor-fighting emphasis. THIS IS NOT YET RE-MEASURED: the approved image in the manifest was made with `_clauseAsValidated`, so re-QC this design at seed 88421 before trusting the new clause, and restore nothing by hand — if it regresses, strengthen the assertions.
mob-bramble-stalker._clauseAsValidated: a PLANT MONSTER made entirely of woven green bramble cane, NOT a person, NOT a ninja, no clothing, no skin, no hair, the whole body is bundled living cane and thorn, two long whip-arms of hooked thorn instead of hands, headless — a dark hollow opening where a face would be, trailing roots instead of feet, bark-black old wood and bright green new growth
